meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描 Azure 云上应用的可靠性短板,并一步步带你修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在用 Azure 跑生产应用,担心单点故障和容灾能力。
copy.tagline_en: Scan your Azure apps for reliability gaps and fix them step by step
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run production apps on Azure and worry about outages.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描你已部署的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源,检查区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探测与多区域故障转移,先给出一张按功能排列的可靠性清单,再在你确认后分阶段用 CLI 或改 IaC 文件来修复。
howto.when: 当你提到「评估可靠性」「检查可靠性」「区域冗余」等关键词,或要求检查高可用、灾难恢复、找单点故障时触发。目前只覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service。

say.text: 帮我评估这个资源组里应用的可靠性状况
say.note: 会先给出按功能分列的清单,再问是否修复

say.text: 我的函数应用是区域冗余的吗?
say.note: 会查询并逐项标出状态

say.text: 为我的 Web 应用设置多区域故障转移
say.note: 会先列出改动和影响并征求同意

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans your deployed Azure Functions and App Service resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes and multi-region failover, shows a feature-pivoted checklist, then applies staged CLI or IaC fixes after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant" and similar keywords, or ask about high availability, disaster recovery or single points of failure. Covers Azure Functions and App Service only.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability posture of the apps in this resource group
say_en.note: Shows a feature-pivoted table, then asks about fixing

say_en.text: Is my function app zone redundant?
say_en.note: Queries and reports the status per feature

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my web app
say_en.note: Lists changes and impact, asks for consent first
